svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Pocket Reader — exploded case assembly view
svg.desc: 2:1 dimetric exploded view of the six-layer case: front frame, e-paper glass, FPC ribbon, PCB, Li-Po cell and rear cover; a 13 mm stack chain on the side.
svg.text: 2:1 dimetric projection · NOT to scale (shows the assembly order and the thickness budget) · source: case.scad + placement.csv

g.text: ⚠ NOT TO SCALE — SHOWS THE ASSEMBLY ORDER
The projection is 2:1 dimetric; plate thicknesses are exaggerated 2x. Real thicknesses are in the stack bar at left.
Part placement is read from placement.csv and case dimensions from case.scad. This is a drawing, not an assembly guide.
Outer size is derived from the glass:

svg.text: The cutouts are opened only in the FRONT FRAME (layer 1); they align with the connector height on the board.
usb_z / sw_z / btn_z are approximate in case.scad — the board must be fitted and measured with calipers.
Assembly order: 1 body → 2 glass → 3 FPC → 4 PCB → 5 battery → 6 cover. The glass is inserted from inside, BEHIND the front frame.
All dimensions are read from the case.scad parameter block; part positions come from placement.csv. Not to scale.
